files.holds: The account: handle, name, since when, and the email of its Google account if it has one.
The devices signed in to the account, by the name each gave.
The tokens given to other programs: names, scopes and dates. No secrets.
Every flight of the account, public or not, newest first: what the server worked out of each file. The files are under flights/.
The groups the account is in, each with who keeps it.
The plans the account posted to its groups, and the plans of others it said it is in on. Plans for days gone by are no longer kept.

What the account gave to the take-offs and landings that pilots make: every revision it wrote (number 1 made the site), and where it says it took off. The sites were given to everyone and stay when the account goes.
The sites the account keeps as its own, each as it was when kept, and the identifiers of those it forgot lately.
The reports the account sent to whoever runs the server, as it sent them.
The account's alarms, and what they fired in the last 30 days.

not_included: The password and the secrets of sessions and tokens. The server keeps only a fingerprint of each and cannot hand one out.
Live tracks. The server keeps one for a short time after its last position and then removes it; the flight reaches the logbook as a file.
What other pilots put into the groups: their names as members, and their plans unless this account said it is in on them.
What whoever runs the server noted about a report, and reports others sent.
What this account withdrew: a deleted flight, a forgotten site's record, a confirmation taken back.
